rules.title: Rules

deal.title: Deck and deal
deal.text: The game uses a 24, 36 or 52 card deck. Everyone gets six cards, the next one is turned face up under the deck — its suit is trump for the whole game. That trump card stays part of the deck and is drawn last.

firstMove.title: First move
firstMove.text: The holder of the lowest trump leads. If nobody has a trump, the lowest card leads. The player to the attacker's left defends.

defend.title: Defending
defend.text: Beat a card with a higher card of the same suit, or with any trump if the attack is not a trump. A trump can only be beaten by a higher trump — suits never mix.

throwIn.title: Throwing in
throwIn.text: You may only throw in a rank already on the table — both attacking cards and the ones used to defend count. The number of attacking cards in a bout never exceeds six, nor the defender's hand size at the start of the bout.

endBout.title: Ending a bout
endBout.text: If everything is beaten and nobody throws in, all cards go to the discard and the defender becomes the attacker. If the defender takes, they collect everything including their own defending cards, and the turn passes to the next player after them.

draw.title: Drawing
draw.text: After each bout players draw back up to six: the attacker first, then anyone who threw in clockwise, the defender last. Once the deck is empty there is no drawing.

end.title: End of the game
end.text: A player left with no cards while the deck is empty is out and safe. The fool is the last one holding cards. If everyone runs out at once and draws are enabled, the game is a draw.

examples.higher: A higher card of the same suit
examples.trump: Any trump — spades are trumps here
examples.sameRank: Throw in a card of the same rank

rules.modesIntro: The table creator picks the mode and the rules. You can see them in the strip at the top of the table.

throwIn.title: Throw-in
throwIn.text: The classic: the attacker and the neighbours throw in cards of the same rank; the defender beats them or takes.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.text: Until a card has been beaten, the defender may add a card of the same rank instead — the attack moves on to the next player.

showTrump.title: Transfer with a trump
showTrump.text: You may transfer just by showing a trump of that rank — the card stays in your hand.

jokers.title: Jokers
jokers.text: Two jokers join the deck. A joker beats any card and nothing beats a joker. Jokers cannot be thrown in or transferred.

cheaters.title: With cheats
cheaters.text: Spend coins to peek at the deck or at an opponent’s hand. Taking back a move works at any table.

draw.title: Draw
draw.text: If everyone runs out of cards at once, the deal is a draw and the bets go back.
